definitions.explanation: A person who holds a position of authority in an organization, company, or association. Includes directors, officers, and committee members.

examples.japanese: {役員|やくいん}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役員|やくいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: He was chosen as a company executive.

examples.japanese: PTA ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役員|やくいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧になった。
examples.english: The PTA officers rotate every year, so this year it became my turn.

notes:
{役員|やくいん} refers to people in leadership or governing positions in organizations.

FORMS:
⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role, duty) + {員|いん} (member)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役員|やくいん}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: board meeting
- {役員|やくいん}{報酬|ほうしゅう}: executive compensation
- {役員|やくいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as an officer
- {役員|やくいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take office as an executive

USAGE:
Used for corporate executives (⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧), committee officers (PTA, neighborhood associations), and organizational leaders.
